description: HITL Workflow Governance zone-based checkpoint requirements

Zone3.regulatoryContext: FINRA Rule 3110 requires supervisory review of customer-facing AI agent outputs. SOX Section 302/404 requires documented internal controls for financial operations.

Zone2.regulatoryContext: FINRA Rule 3110(b) recommends structured oversight for shared agent outputs. GLBA Section 501(b) requires safeguards for customer financial information.

Zone1.regulatoryContext: Best practice: periodic spot-check of personal agent outputs for quality assurance.

Unclassified.regulatoryContext: Environment requires zone classification before HITL policy can be enforced.
